d: Rich zodiacal constellation delineating the Teapot asterism in the direction of the Milky Way galactic core.

hip-90185.x: Brightest star in Sagittarius, a luminous blue-white giant marking the southern base of the Teapot bow.

hip-92855.x: Ancient Babylonian landmark star, a hot B-type dwarf forming the vane of the Teapot handle.

gaia-4076915349846977664.x: Orange giant star marking the lid apex of the familiar Teapot asterism.

gaia-4075141768785646848.x: One of the nearest known stars to the Sun (~9.7 ly), an active red dwarf in the northern reaches of Sagittarius.

gaia-4049975081571729920.x: Orange giant star forming the sharp tip of the Teapot spout pointing toward the galactic center.

gaia-4038055447778237312.x: Multiple star system containing an evolved red giant marking the southern foot of the archer.
